programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang kommer det desværre virkelig til at handle om alle dem der IKKE hjælper. Vi kører i S-tog med en mand med sennep og ketchup i hele masken og vælter flere gange en helt tårn med toiletpapir ned i hoved på en ung pige OG ingen hjælper…

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi fortæller om, hvordan det er, når vi skal finde en kvinde på gaden, som vi kan gøre gravid. Det er en vild, sjov og skør opgave. Vi har også en medvirkende, der virkelig er presset over hendes opgave og så én, der ikke fatter, hvad der ramte ham.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi sminker Pelle 80 år gammel og lader den gamle mand tabe bukserne foran en masse måbende cafegæster. Samtidig overrasker en rimelig ordinær video med en kvinde, der skal ind i et tog med en barnevogn – den går nemlig viralt!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi forsætter med de voldsomme videoer, når vi sammen med DBU og Salling Group sætter fokus på de grimme tilråb forældre har, når deres små poder spiller bold. Hør blandt andet, hvorfor vi vælger at tage de værste tilråb først.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Bedst som René og Pelle troede, at det at hjælpe i ”Den Gode Gerning” udelukkende var for ældre mennesker, så kommer de unge på banen. Dagens videoer er fulde af dejlige unge mennesker, der springer til og på skønneste vis giver håb for ungdommen.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Igen tager drengene med deres kamera ud til skønne mennesker, der er noget for andre. Og i den nordjyske by Hals, falder de over en mand, der har en skøn historie fra sin tid som spejder – en historie, der til stadighed får ham til at gøre gode gerninger.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Normalt hylder vi folk, der reagerer på vores små set ups rundt omkring, men her hylder vi folk, der til dagligt gør gode gerninger – og vi tager hyldesterne til nye højder, så vildt at en af dem kalder det ”SVINERI”!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: ”Den Gode Gerning” er skudt i gang, og som noget nyt hylder Pelle og René folk, der til dagligt gør en forskel for andre. Det bliver virkelig rørende, da de hjælper brystkræftramte Malene med at sige tak til hendes hjælpsomme veninde Michelle.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Vi ved godt, at det er tarveligt at bruge små søde børn, der har brug for hjælp. Det er nemlig et billigt trick, MEN det virker. Og en ting er, at set up’et er sødt, men ham der hjælpers reaktion er virkelig også skøn – det er jul, når det er bedst!

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter

programme.title: Masterchef - Danmarks største madtalenter
programme.desc: Et stort twist rammer, da nye og gamle deltagere mødes, og følelserne sidder udenpå tøjet. Farven på forklædet afgør deres skæbne og hvilke råvarer, de skal arbejde med.

programme.title: Med kniven for struben: Episode 505

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Tanned Triangle

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Good Riddance

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Just Another Day at the Shore
programme.desc: Beboerne i huset samles om Snooki, og efter slåskampen i byen og det brutale slag, er det overraskende resultat, at det bringer huset tættere sammen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Nana Joins The Gang
programme.desc: Sophie undskylder for at slå Sam, og geordierne har en sjov dag i vandparken. De tager på natklub med Abbies mormor, og det bringer familien tæt på hinanden igen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: A Double Return
programme.desc: Sophie bliver helt målløs, når Aussie Alex kommer på overraskelsesbesøg. Huset er helt oppe at køre, da Holly vender tilbage ot tager dem til Newcastle Pride for at more sig, drikke og danse!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Holly Gets A Shock
programme.desc: Chloe tager Sam med på en hemmelig date, der giver ham gåsehus. Alex må virkelig fedte for Sophie, og Scotty T gør livet svært for Holly, da han tager hendes eks Kyle med på et job.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Geordie Fest

programme.title: Geordie Shore: All Change In The House

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Makeovers

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: PR-fotos

programme.title: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team: Finalen

programme.desc: Ryan and Brent explore the theories surrounding the deaths of legends Tupac Shakur and Biggie Smalls.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Kidnapping
programme.desc: In 2001, Ginger Hayes and her infant son were abducted during a carjacking. The crime had been reported by a witness within minutes of occurrence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Vanished
programme.desc: In New York, an ambitious college student has her whole life ahead of her, until she crosses the path of a killer. It's a random murder, the hardest kind to solve.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions
programme.desc: Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The Maury Show: I'm 45, Is My 29 Year Old Son Is Not Your Baby's Dad!
programme.desc: Is Justin cheating on Tammy with her daughter Summa? Did Darrin cheat on Amanda with her daughter Lydia? Lie detector test results will determine the fates for the accused!

programme.title: The Maury Show: Did My Daughter Sleep With My Man?
programme.desc: The guests on today’s MAURY have secrets to reveal, but will they regret ever bringing them up? Relationships are on the line. Hearts may be broken. Can these couples survive the secrets that threaten to tear them apart? Find out on today’s MAURY!

programme.title: The Maury Show: 10 Moms. 12 Kids. Who’s The Dad? Part 1
programme.desc: We’ve got so much paternity action we can’t fit it all in one show. “You Are the Father” could be the sweetest words these men could ever hear. Will the results make our guests cheer or tear?

programme.title: The Maury Show: I Had a Threesome…Who's My Baby's Dad?
programme.desc: Rhonda is positive that John is the father of her child. Even John’s mother agrees with her! Then, Kim and Heather used to be best friends. But that was before Rick left her for Heather. But Kim is sure that Rick fathered her baby. What is the truth?

programme.title: The Maury Show: Did My Husband or Lover Father My Kids?
programme.desc: Is Jesus the father of Laicie’s baby? Dusti says he’s gay and sex with Kayla was an “experiment”, but did he father her child? Is Rick or Jesse the father of Jolene’s baby?

programme.title: The Maury Show: Is My Sister Sleeping With My Man?
programme.desc: Sherry has a shocking secret to tell her boyfriend. But the secret involves his childhood best friend. Jen says that her husband is a cheater and has proof! Will these relationships survive?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Where is Claudia Jane
programme.desc: 15-year old CJ Bates is reported missing, and Kenda must investigate the mysterious circumstances behind the disappearance of the teenager.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Manifesto
programme.desc: A cabin on the slopes of Pikes Peak catches fire, and a young sheriff’s deputy is posted to guard the scene overnight--then he’s found dead in his patrol car the next morning.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: My, My, Merry Christmas
programme.desc: Donald Ott is found shot to death, friends tell police he didn’t have an enemy in the world. But when Lt. Joe Kenda speaks with family, he learns of a relative who might hold the key to the mystery.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Red Highway
programme.desc: The elderly owners of a local grocery are attacked and left for dead. Working with a vague witness description, Lt. Joe Kenda leads a state-wide manhunt to catch a pair of cold-blooded killers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sacrificial Lamb
programme.desc: When 13yr old PJ Grant is found dead from a single gunshot wound to the head, Kenda assumes it’s a suicide. When the physical evidence doesn’t add up, it opens the door to a world of possibilities.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: To The Death
programme.desc: When two young men are found shot in an apartment hallway, Kenda must rely on his inner lie detector to figure out which victim was no victim at all.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Advances, Cassini at Saturn & More About Mars
programme.desc: Project Gemini Advances - NASA refines the techniques needed for rendezvous. Cassini at Saturn - In the Cassini probe's final years of activity, its handlers are asking it to do more complex and risky assignments.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 4: Black Holes
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 8: Extravehicular Activity
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication
programme.desc: Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: The story of brothers Erik and Lyle Menendez, convicted of the brutal murders of their wealthy parents.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: On March 30, 1985, in Lynchburg, someone viciously murdered one of the state's FFV--First Families of Virginia--and her husband. Someone entered Derek and Nancy Haysom's home and attacked the couple--he was stabbed 39 times, she was nearly decapitated.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: To hear residents tell the story, murder doesn't happen in Fresno--at least not in the well-heeled suburbs.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: Factor X
programme.desc: Musicians who write about crime are often accused of condoning, even glorifying, criminal activity.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: City Under Siege
programme.desc: When a jury acquitted four Los Angeles police officers of using excessive force during Rodney King’s arrest, a mass protest against police brutality, injustice and racial discrimination ensued and quickly turned into a riot.

programme.title: iCarly: En megafed idé
programme.desc: Da frøken Briggs nægter at lade alle Carly og Sams favoritter deltage i talentshowet, beslutter de at være værter for deres dygtige klassekammerater på deres egen onlinewebshow, iCarly.

programme.title: iCarly: Hr. Næsten Perfekt
programme.desc: Carly er lun på Jake, som går på skolen. Han er supercool og ser godt ud. Carly er vild med Jake, så hun inviterer ham til at spille guitar og synge i hendes nye webshow. Hun finder desværre ud af, at Jake er en forfærdelig sanger.

programme.title: iCarly: Kampagne-konkurrencen
programme.desc: Carly og Sam konkurrerer mod Freddie og Spencer om hvem, der kan få flest børn til at se iCarly webcast. Men det stikker helt af, da alle deres planer går grueligt galt.

programme.title: iCarly: En anmelders gunst
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie vil gerne have deres webshow anmeldt af 'Nevelocity', et superpopulært websted, der anmeldelser hjemmesider og webcasts. Da Carly skal møde Nevel finder hun ud af, at han er en irriterende dreng, der gerne vil på date med hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Ude godt, men Spencer er bedst
programme.desc: Carly og Spencers bedstefar kommer på uanmeldt besøg. Han er meget bekymret for, om Spencer er for uansvarlig og skør til at være Carlys værge. Det er op til Carly og hendes venner at overbevise hendes bedstefar om, at Spencer er en ansvarlig værge.

programme.title: iCarly: Rekordforsøget
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver at slå verdensrekorden i den længste, sammenhængende webcast. For at slå rekorden skal iCarly være på i mere end 24 timer i træk.

programme.title: iCarly: En date med Freddie
programme.desc: En iCarly-fan, Valerie, inviterer Freddie på en date. Daten går så godt, at Freddie begynder at filme Valeries eget webshow. Men Freddie føler sig splittet, da Valeries webshow skaber problemer for iCarly-webshowet.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Det tog Malte Ebert cirka 2 sekunder at overveje, om han ville være med i en video, hvor vi hylder skønne, hjælpsomme Cecilie, der elsker Malte. Kom bag om videoen, hvor vi sammen med Malte og 100 andre tager fusen på Cecilie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Der går nærmest hjælpemiddelcentral i den i de videoer, der med i dag – to ældre mennesker med rollatorer og Pelle i en rullestol. Det er med andre ord scenarier med folk, der virkelig har brug for hjælp og dermed ekstra rørende, når folk springer til.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En ellers lidt ordinær video EKSPLODEREDE på Tik Tok, da en mand der hjalp sagde nej til Pelles blomster med ordene ”Nej tak, jeg er til kvinder – helst!”. Vi taler om, hvad der har overrasket os i forhold til hvilke videoer der når langt ud.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Pelle og René sætter ord på tilblivelsen af ”Den Gode Gerning”. Hør hvordan René nærmest ved et tilfælde bliver revet med i foretagendet, og så står de med en vild opdagelse efter, de har optaget de første videoer – det er kun de ”gamle” der hjælper!!

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: En af de bedste gerninger, man kan gøre, er at sige noget pænt til en fremmed. Det er vi ikke så gode til her i landet, derfor lader vi selvfølgelig en mand gøre det. Det er SÅ fedt, dejligt og tankevækkende at se folks reaktioner på de søde ord.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Hvordan går det, når vi har allieret os med TV-værten Anders Breinholt? – det bliver lidt noget rod, og senere, så ender vi i et kæmpe dilemma, når der pludselig er flere, der springer til for at hjælpe – og vi har kun én præmie.

programme.title: Den Gode Gerning
programme.desc: Denne her gang fortæller vi blandt andet om den nok mest populære video, vi har lavet – en video med Lukas Graham, der overrasker en hjælpsom fan, 10-årige Felix. Felix er SÅ sødt og hans reaktion trækker tårer hos alle der ser videoen.

programme.desc: Hvis der er en, du gerne vil ud og køre en tur med, så er det Kevin Mensah. Og nu har du muligheden. Sæt dig i bilen med humørbomben med det enorme vinderinstinkt og hør om op- og nedture i Brøndby, om træningskultur, mesterskabet - og det der ikke blev.

programme.title: BrøndbyLyd: Bag facaden: Elias Broberg: Stort at skrive første kontrakt med Brøndby IF
programme.desc: 15-årige Elias Broberg er en rigtig Brøndby-dreng, og 3point.dk var med på sidelinjen, da han skrev under på sin første kontrakt med hjerteklubben. Hør fra Broberg selv, men også fra head of coaching i Brøndby IF Bjørn Holm.

programme.title: 3point.dk: Tæt på: Jacob Rasmussen: Jeg sætter en ære i at forsvare
programme.desc: Venstrebenet taler for sig selv, men Jacob Rasmussen er også braget ind i hjerterne på Brøndby-fansene med en hårdhed i duellerne, som matcher den rå beton, og en vindermentalitet, som folk elsker. Lær midtstopperen bedre at kende.

programme.title: 3point.dk: Tæt på: Mads Juel Andersen: Stadig en drøm at spille for Brøndby
programme.desc: Han nåede aldrig at få sit gennembrud i hjerteklubben Brøndby IF, men nu spiller Mads Juel Andersen i stedet i Premier League. Han drømmer dog stadig om at komme tilbage i gult og blåt i fremtiden, for det er som om, der er noget uafsluttet for ham.

programme.title: 3point.dk: Tæt på: Mathias Kvistgaarden om opvæksten, aggressivitet og den ultimative drøm
programme.desc: Mathias Kvistgaarden har udviklet sig til at være en stor profil for Brøndby IF på tærsklen til et udlandseventyr. I dette interview kan du møde en ung Kvistgaarden inden han overhovedet kom i nærheden af Superliga-truppen.

programme.title: 3point.dk: Stemningsvideoer: Lyden af Sydsiden: Stemningsvideoer fra tribunen (AGF, AAB og RFC)
programme.desc: Genoplev stemningen fra tribunen! Brøndbys fans leverer altid en fantastisk stemning - ude såvel som hjemme. I denne video kan du se stemningsvideoer fra kampene mod AGF, AAB og RFC.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Majse vælger Adam frem for Jan Erik. Mercedes og Isabelle sejler til Sicilien. Sten og Jan Erik har forskellige planer. Sten er vred over fyringen og Hannes affære med Jens Erik.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Jan Erik fester med unge piger nu, hvor han er alene. Mercedes kommer hjem fra Italien til eksamen, og Jan Erik pynter op. Hun ankommer med helikopter og mødes af Freja og Simon. Per fortæller Sten om Gudrun, som ryster ham. Gymnasiet brænder senere.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Gymnasiet er brændt, og Gudrun er væk efter at have snydt med sine papirer. Hans fortæller Sten, at kommunen ikke vil give penge til genopbygning. Jan Erik køber hus ved siden af Mercedes, der sørger over sin hund. Jens Erik skal skilles fra Thomas.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Mercedes tager sin hund til dyrehospitalet, og Michael kommer med blomster som undskyldning. Jens Erik er glad for Stens gymnasieuheld. Sten og Hanne går til borgmesterens reception. Gert ringer til Jan Erik fra fængslet, mens Kevin overvåger Mercedes.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Hanne møder Hans Holm på en løbetur, der tilbyder hende cykelhjælp hjem. Freja bliver vred under et radiointerview, hvor hendes far angribes. Simon vil eje radiostationen, men ved ikke, at Jens Erik og andre arbejder på en havn, der vil rive den ned.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Simon beder Sten om råd før købet af radiostationen. Jan Erik skjuler Mercedes' hund, da hun vil rejse til Italien. Mercedes er vred over, at politiet ikke leder efter hunden. Hans inviterer Hanne til Paris, og Michael frier til Mercedes, men begge afslås

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Simon vil købe radioen og søger job hos Jens Erik. Han arbejder nu med IT hos KE Invest. Michael giver Mercedes en ring. Gert vil købe Londongrunden, men Jan Erik afviser. Benedikte vil have Jens Erik gift og har fundet en kvinde.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Simon køber radioen, hvilket overrasker Jens Erik, der også ville købe den. Simon, Freja, Silke og Torleif planlægger en stor åbning. Mercedes må blive pga. helikopterproblemer. Jan Erik beder Sten undersøge Gerts papirer.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Hanne får jobtilbud, men er usikker på hvorfor. Sten afviser Jan Eriks samarbejde. Jens Erik og Hans Holm lokkes til radioen, hvor en tv-station stiller kritiske spørgsmål. Jens Erik bliver rasende og de flygter. Gert har en kontakt i Jan Eriks hus.

programme.title: 2900 Happiness
programme.desc: Sten har fødselsdag og får et gevær af Jan Erik. Freja møder Karl Erik under optagelser til radioen. Hans' tale mod havneudbygningen får kommunen til at trække sig. Jens Erik indser vigtigheden af at være med i logen, hvor beslutninger træffes.

programme.title: 7th Heaven

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
programme.desc: Hiding a body can be difficult; it's sometimes easier to obscure or disguise the circumstances of the death, turning murder into suicide, or pinning the blame on someone else. The truth is told through subtle clues taken from the crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lasting Impressions
programme.desc: No matter how chaotic or how clean a crime scene appears to be, the culprit is bound to leave something telling behind. Occasionally, it's nothing more than a fingerprint or shoe tread. Sometimes that's all that's needed.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Dealings
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Body Count
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder, at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their undoing.

programme.title: The Maury Show: Is My Sister Sleeping With My Man?
programme.desc: Sherry has a shocking secret to tell her boyfriend. But the secret involves his childhood best friend. Jen says that her husband is a cheater and has proof! Will these relationships survive?

programme.title: The Maury Show: I Cheated... Our Kids May Not Be Yours!
programme.desc: Two steaming grandmothers want to sort out their children's paternity mystery. Then, Ben is sure that Angela's child is his. Teen mom Melissa wants Izzy to admit he's the dad and support her!

programme.title: The Maury Show: They're Back: Feuding Family Updates!
programme.desc: Some of our wildest guests return to give us some updates. Did the DNA results force these denying dads to step up? Did the lie detector results force these cheaters to become faithful?

programme.title: The Maury Show: I Cheated With Your Family and 97 Women
programme.desc: These women are sure their lovers are cheating. Will these men be able to talk their way out of being busted on a hidden camera?

programme.title: The Maury Show: 5 Babies 5 DNA Tests. Is He The Father?
programme.desc: Today on Maury, we've got steaming mad mommas and daddies in denial. But could some of these men be right? What if they really aren't the father? Only Maury has the answers!

programme.title: The Maury Show: We'll Prove You're My Baby's Dad!
programme.desc: Kreisha and Jonathan's mom wants to prove to him that he fathered her baby. Plus, Brooke and Wade's relationship began as a teenage romance, but ends with a paternity test!

programme.title: The Maury Show: Where Did My Man Learn New Sex Moves?
programme.desc: Has pregnant Kazia's fiancé been cheating on her and selling his body? Then, has Deanna been cheating on Manny? Who fathered her child?

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: To The Death
programme.desc: When two young men are found shot in an apartment hallway, Kenda must rely on his inner lie detector to figure out which victim was no victim at all.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: The Cage
programme.desc: Kenda finds the bullet-ridden bodies of a middle-aged couple in a musty suburban house alongside the corpses of their two beloved pets.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Officer Down
programme.desc: Sgt. Joe Kenda is faced with his worst nightmare when he learns a friend and fellow officer, Mark Dabling, has been killed in the line of duty.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Make My Day
programme.desc: When Keith Andrews is killed, a man steps forward claiming he did it in self-defense—but Lt. Joe Kenda has his doubts.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: When the Music Stops
programme.desc: Vietnam War veteran Charles Walker is found unconscious, after a stabbing attack so savage even 45 units of blood couldn’t save his life.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini, Venus Express, EMU & Deep Space Communication
programme.desc: Project Gemini Commences - Did Gemini give the US a lead in the space race? Venus Express - The last days of ESA's Venus probe. EMU - NASA's Extravehicular Mobility Unit. Deep Space Communications - ESA's worldwide network of giant dishes.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Amazing Cassini spacecraft and its sibling lander, Huygens, have now concluded their scientific studies, bringing back years of data. Now, Juno piercing the cloak of Jupiter and her distant relative New Horizons at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programme.desc: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.

programme.title: The Apollo Experience: Apollo 17: Part 2
programme.desc: In this episode, hear first hand testimonials and dialogue from the incredible men who walked on the moon. Incredible footage and photos give a unique and beautiful experience of their data collection process and journey home.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Beyond Earth Orbit, IXV Vehicles & Galileo Satellites Lost and Found
programme.desc: Beyond Earth Orbit - The Apollo program takes bold new steps. IXV Re-entry Vehicle - Europe is working to perfect a re-entry vehicle. Galileo Satellites Lost and Found - Navigation satellites go into incorrect orbit.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Space is vast, yet it is full of collisions. Gas and dust electrostatically flock together, and gravity takes over coalescing grains into rocks. Those rocks become boulders, then asteroids colliding again and again, striking planets and each other.

programme.title: The Truth is in the Stars
programme.desc: Does our society have the capacity to live up to Star Trek's optimistic vision for humanity's future? William Shatner takes us on a journey to find out whether art has imitated life in the years since the world-renowned TV series premiered in 1966.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: City Under Siege
programme.desc: When a jury acquitted four Los Angeles police officers of using excessive force during Rodney King’s arrest, a mass protest against police brutality, injustice and racial discrimination ensued and quickly turned into a riot.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: Beautiful World?
programme.desc: Four unarmed students were shot and killed, and another nine wounded, by members of the Ohio National Guard at a peace rally held at Kent State University on May 4, 1970.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: Under A Darkened Veil
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Brenda Spencer began shooting at children from her house to the Cleveland Elementary School, San Diego, with a semi-automatic rifle her father had given to her as a Christmas present.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: The Killing Fields
programme.desc: In 1960s England, Ian Brady and Myra Hindley preyed upon children in the Manchester area and buried their bodies at Saddleworth Moor.

programme.title: Killer Soundtrack: Myth, or Murder
programme.desc: Infamous mobster Al Capone lived a life of crime, and yet he has become part of popular culture and inspired numerous art forms.

programme.title: SvampeBob Firkant
programme.desc: SvampeBob Firkant, Patrick Søstjerne og alle de andre venner fra undervandsbyen Bikini Bunden er klar på masser af sjov og eventyr på kanalen, som viser den amerikanske animationsserie døgnet rundt!

programme.title: iCarly: En date med Freddie
programme.desc: En iCarly-fan, Valerie, inviterer Freddie på en date. Daten går så godt, at Freddie begynder at filme Valeries eget webshow. Men Freddie føler sig splittet, da Valeries webshow skaber problemer for iCarly-webshowet.

programme.title: iCarly: Kunstneriske kvaler
programme.desc: Carly inviterer Spencers kunsthelt, Harry Joyner, til at kigge på Spencers kunstværker. Da Harry kalder Spencers kunst for amatøragtigt, føler Spencer, at hans liv ikke længere giver mening.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarlys største fan
programme.desc: iCarlys største fan, Mandy, inviteres til at se en livesending af iCarly. Men Mandy viser sig at være mere stalker end fan, så de må gøre alt for at slippe af med hende.

programme.title: iCarly: Rugemor
programme.desc: Carly og Sam forsøger at udklække kyllinger i et naturvidenskabsprojekt. Men æggene klækker tidligere end forventet, og pludselig er der kyllinger overalt i lejligheden! Carly, Sam, Freddie og Spencer må finde kyllingerne i lejligheden.

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg gider ikke slås
programme.desc: Carly laver en en unik iCarly T-shirt til Sam for at markere årsdagen for deres venskab. Men da Sam bytter den for koncertbilletter, bliver de to venner uvenner.

programme.title: iCarly: Dansegal
programme.desc: iCarly beder sine fans om at sende videoer ind af dem dem selv, når de danser deres sejeste danse. Over tre tusind danseklip kommer ind, og Carly, Sam og Freddie prøver at holde sig vågne hele natten for at se dem.

programme.title: iCarly: Halloween-forskrækkelser
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie sender iCarly fra en lejlighed, som det siges at spøge i. Da der begynder at ske underlige ting begynder vennerne også at frygte, at spøgelsesrygterne er sande.

programme.title: iCarly: Lad der angres
programme.desc: Spencer redder livet på hovedsangeren i The Plain White T's og får ham til at deltage i iCarly. Mærkelige ting begynder at gå galt midt i Carlys, Sams og Freddies netvideosending.

programme.title: iCarly: Så er der eftersidning
programme.desc: Sam må sidde efter den aften iCarly holder sin 50. netvideosending. Carly og Freddie kan ikke gøre, som de plejer, så de prøver, så godt de kan, at få eftersidning, så de kan sende fra skolebænken med Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Vi sælger tech-foots!
programme.desc: Carly, Sam og Freddie bliver inviteret til Dakas hovedkvarter, der de bliver tilbudt en stor pengesum for at reklamere for Dakas nye sko, Tech-foden, på iCarly. Men det viser sig, at skoene er forfærdelige.

programme.desc: Se, hvordan ejerne af Englands historiske Holdenby House holder det profitabelt.

programme.desc: Egyptian artifacts were stolen from the British Museum. Included: panels from a tomb in Saqqara, an ancient burial ground.

programme.title: Return of the Bible Plagues: Mosquitos

programme.title: On the Case: Courage and Conviction
